name: cloudflare-clef
description: Decision evaluation on Cloudflare Workers AI CLEF / CLEF Flash, exposed as the MCP tool clef_evaluate. Credentials are DPAPI-encrypted at rest. Images attach by absolute local file path or embedded data URL. Protocol layer ported verbatim from the MIT-licensed OpenClaw plugin openclaw-cloudflare-clef 0.1.3.
